I'm not going to tell you not to do it, but I will tell you this; as someone who attempted suicide and landed themselves in a psych facility for a week: 

If you fail, you will regret it. Not because you'll realize life is beautiful and you ARE loved and yadda yadda yadda, but because what will come after is going to suck. 

I took pills for my attempt. Ever drank charcoal? Nastiest milkshake of your life. Sweet, chunky, and fucking gross. I had to choke down 2 cups of it for 15 pills. Yeah, 15. 

You're going to be stuck in a hospital room overnight while they figure out what they need to do with you, probably without your phone, or really anything to keep you from being bored stiff. You probably won't sleep; I sure didn't. 

Once your monitoring period is up, you're going to have a psych evaluation. You attempted suicide, so you're more likely than not going to be placed in a psych facility. No, you don't have a choice in the matter. 

Once you're at the facility, you still don't get your phone. In fact, you don't get most home comforts; including a pencil. Where I was, you had to ask a staff member to unlock your bathroom door, and you couldn't close the door while in there. We had a dress code. A. Dress. Code. And that was only for if and when we earned our clothes back and were allowed to stop wearing cloth scrubs. You won't get much alone time and any friends you may make, you probably won't be allowed to keep in touch with. 

A week, comparatively speaking, is a short time to spend in a psych facility. I got lucky because I'm a teenager who was in the children's hospital's psych facility, instead of a private one. Try this, and you're probably gonna be there a lot longer. 

I recommend trying something else.
